**7B.8 Verdict: mostly no**
The 2024 record looks like opportunistic public positioning rather than reliable commitment-keeping. Putin did make some narrow, real concessions to technocratic judgment and did use formal rhetoric about peace or restraint, but the stronger pattern is concealment, scapegoating, censorship, and maximalist conditional offers that function more like leverage than promises.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| Negative | Putin lets “economically significant” entities limit information disclosures | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-01-29 | https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001 | Putin reduced disclosure requirements for powerful firms, making it harder to see insider privilege, hidden tradeoffs, and who benefits from state decisions. | 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7 |
| Negative | Russia: Freedom in the World 2024 | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says the Kremlin manipulates elections, suppresses opposition, and controls media. That is a broad pattern of misleading public legitimacy claims rather than honest constraint by formal commitments. | 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.1 |
| Negative | Russia: Freedom on the Net 2024 | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-net/2024 | The report says the state expanded censorship, propaganda, surveillance, and manipulation of online information. That is direct evidence of managing public perception rather than letting facts constrain the ruler. | 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7 |
| Negative | Russia’s presidential vote starts final day with accusations of Kyiv sabotage | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-03-16 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russias-presidential-vote-starts-final-day-with-accusations-of-kyiv-sabotage-3341069 | Reuters described Putin’s landslide in a race lacking serious competition, with imprisoned opponents and censorship narrowing the contest. That supports the view that formal political competition was manipulated, not honored. | 7B.8, 7B.1, 7B.6, 7B.7 |
| Negative | Putin says Russia ready for peace talks, but only on his terms | President of Russia | 2024-06-14 | https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/74285 | Putin said Russia was ready for negotiations only if Ukraine withdrew from occupied regions and abandoned NATO. That is a conditional ultimatum, not a good-faith commitment to compromise or de-escalation. | 7B.8, 7B.1, 7B.6 |
| Negative | Putin says Russia’s economy is overheating, inflation is worrying | Reuters via MarketScreener | 2024-12-19 | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Putin-says-Russia-s-economy-is-overheating-inflation-is-worrying-48625233/ | Putin admitted macro stress, but Reuters reported he also blamed Western sanctions and a bad harvest. This is partial acknowledgment mixed with scapegoating, not full candor about tradeoffs. | 7B.8, 7B.2 |
| Negative | Russia to curb income of foreign agents and those who leave, lawmaker says | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-11-07 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-to-curb-income-of-foreign-agents-and-those-who-leave-lawmaker-says-3707363 | Russia moved to punish critics and exiles through livelihood rules, which is consistent with concealing tradeoffs and suppressing corrective scrutiny. | 7B.8, 7B.6, 7B.7 |
| Weak positive | Putin does not simply overrule the central bank, backs tight policy | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-12-20 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-central-bank-keeps-rates-on-hold-after-putins-call-for-balance-3784135 | Putin publicly backed the central bank’s tight policy rather than forcing an easier political line. This is limited evidence of deference to expertise, but not of broad commitment-keeping. | 7B.8, 7B.5, 7B.6 |
| Weak positive | Putin relayed a ceasefire proposal through mediators | Reuters via Ukrainska Pravda | 2024-02-13 | https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2024/02/13/7441736/ | Reuters reported an indirect ceasefire channel, which suggests some willingness to talk. The evidence is secondhand and does not show durable compromise or respected commitments. | 7B.8, 7B.1 |
| Weak positive | Putin said the tactical nuclear drill was “not about using these weapons” | President of Russia | 2024-05-09 | https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/transcripts/74002 | Putin used restraint-flavored rhetoric during a live exercise, but the surrounding context was escalation, so this is only weak evidence of keeping public reassurance consistent with behavior. | 7B.8, 7B.1, 7B.6 |

**Search gap**
I did not find strong 2024 evidence that Putin kept major formal commitments in a durable way. The clearest positive material is narrow and reactive, especially deference to the central bank and a few diplomatic or restraint-flavored statements. By contrast, the stronger evidence points to selective disclosure, scapegoating, censorship, and conditional bargaining that looks opportunistic rather than reliable.
